options.COOPERATE: Coordinate intersection passage via the fleet agent's alternating yield system.
options.INDEPENDENT: Use only onboard sensors to traverse intersections without external coordination.
options.COMPETE_EXPLOIT: Force intersection priority by maintaining full speed and overriding yield rules.
options.DISENGAGE: Withdraw vehicles to charging stations and suspend all inventory transport.
